A skill to interact with Gaode Map (AMap) for location search and route planning.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Gaode Map Skill.

- Enables searching for places (POIs) using the Gaode Map (AMap) API.
- Supports route planning between locations with multiple travel modes (driving, walking, bicycling, transit).
- Usage via the command-line script `amap_tool.py`.
- Requires an AMAP API key set through the `AMAP_API_KEY` environment variable.
